reason: Retain root accessor and guarded hierarchy registration. All denotes subtree traversal of qualifying nodes, not unconditional insertion: nonzero mode suppresses insertions and 0x1000 prunes descent. The caller retains the selected joint separately from its root; address mappings persist in the default table and duplicate IDs replace data. Parent ascent assumes a valid acyclic hierarchy.

evidence.why: Root ascent and precise registration guards.
Registration precedes archive-backed animation; selected joint preserved.
